mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment and decrease in unemployment rate indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: When new housing starts exceed 700 thousand units, it signals a strengthening housing market that drives consumer spending and corporate investment, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 700, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 225, it signals persistent inflation that prompts central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market regime defined by payroll employment exceeding 130,000 thousand persons, consumer spending and corporate earnings rise, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI and stable or declining FEDFUNDS signals that inflation is outpacing monetary policy response, leading to reduced real rates and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of rising CPI and stable FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression model.
